_README: IMAGE n in 369-attendance-employee-manual.md -> the file below. Drop the capture into this folder under exactly that name and rebuild; nothing in the Markdown changes.
A slot with no file on disk still renders a bordered plate and caption.
Shoot on the phone in portrait. Do not include real personal data.

1.capture: Fresh install (or after Change URL): the Connect to your server screen, STEP 1 OF 2, a test address typed into Server URL, and the green '1 database found · selected automatically' card above an enabled Continue button. The header subtitle names the backend product; blur that line.

2.capture: HAVE IT. Sign-in screen: server strip with a test address, database and Change URL, Welcome back, STEP 2 OF 2, empty Username and Password, Forgot password?, Sign In, and 'You stay signed in until you log out.'

3.capture: Signed in as an ordinary employee (bottom bar shows only Home and Profile), tap the log-out arrow on the Home header: the Log out? window with Cancel and Log out.

4.capture: Ordinary working day, ordinary employee, before checking in: greeting and name, the four header buttons, the attendance card with the Not checked in chip and the Check In button, the Office hours line, and the Home / Profile bar.

5.capture: Ordinary working day, a few minutes after tapping Check In: the green 'Checked in · 5m' chip, the Check In time filled in, the red Check Out button, no three-step bar.

6.capture: HAVE IT. Employee Home (taken on a weekly off): the Worked / Status / Late by tiles, the SEPTEMBER 2026 month card, the four Quick actions, and Recent activity with No check-ins yet, over the Home / Profile bar.

7.capture: HAVE IT. Weekly off before declaring: Weekly off pill, Day off · not declared chip, the 1 Declare / 2 Check in / 3 Check out, earn bar, the amber I'm working today button and the half-day / full-day line.

8.capture: HAVE IT. The Working today? confirmation over Home, with Cancel and I'm working today.

9.capture: HAVE IT. After declaring: Working today · declared chip, step 2 active, Check In button, 'Declared. Check in when you start.' and the Not working after all link.

10.capture: HAVE IT. Checked in on a declared weekly off: Checked in · 2m chip, check-in time, red Check Out, and 'Check out after 4.5 h for a full comp-off day.'

11.capture: HAVE IT. After checking out on the declared day: Done for today chip, all three steps filled, both times, greyed Checked out for today button and 'Earned ½ day of comp-off.'

12.capture: HAVE IT. Leave screen with no requests: filter chips, Paid leave card (12 / 0 / 12, accrual and quota lines), Compensatory off card with 0.5 available and the Comp-off hint, No leave requests yet, and Apply for leave.

13.capture: HAVE IT. Apply for leave sheet, freshly opened: Casual chosen, the other type chips including Comp-off with its 0.5 badge, empty Dates and Reason, Submit request.

14.capture: HAVE IT. The range calendar over the form: 'Tap the first day, then the last', October 2026, the Holiday / Weekly off key, Cancel and Pick a date.

15.capture: HAVE IT. Casual, one day, with the red box 'Only Half day of these 1 day is paid leave ... and deducted from your salary.' and Submit · Half day unpaid (LOP).

16.capture: HAVE IT. Casual, one day, with the red box 'Your paid leave for this month (1 day) is already used ...' and Submit · 1 day unpaid (LOP); the red month line is visible on the Paid leave card behind.

17.capture: HAVE IT. Comp-off chosen with Half day on: 'Paid from your earned days, oldest first' with 27 Sep 2026 Weekly off ½ day, Date 28 Sep 2026, a reason, and Submit · uses ½ day.

18.capture: With HR submit emails switched on in the leave policy, fill in the Apply for leave form and tap Preview email to HR: the Email to HR window with the 'Goes to N people in HR when submitted.' line, the email on white paper with its rows and Review and approve button, and Close. Use a test employee name.

19.capture: HAVE IT. Leave list with a pending Casual Leave (5 – 6 Oct 2026 · 2 days) and a pending Compensatory Off (Uses the day you worked: 27 Sep 2026), each with Cancel request, and the '2 more pending approval' line on the Paid leave card.

20.capture: Tap Cancel request on a pending leave card: the Cancel this request? window ('Your Casual Leave for ... will be withdrawn. You can apply again for the same dates afterwards.') with Keep it and Cancel request.

21.capture: HAVE IT. Ask HR to cancel this leave? over an approved Casual Leave, with a reason typed into Why cancel it? and Keep it / Send to HR. The on-screen keyboard is showing; crop it off if preferred.

22.capture: HAVE IT. The toast 'Cancellation request sent to HR.' at the top and the approved card now reading Cancellation requested · waiting for HR.

23.capture: HAVE IT. Approved Casual Leave after HR declined the cancellation: Approved by line, red 'HR kept this leave: Team short that week', and Request cancellation offered again.

24.capture: HAVE IT. Work from home sheet: Day 29 Sep 2026, a reason, the 'Once approved, check in as usual on the day ...' note, Submit request.

25.capture: HAVE IT. Work from home list: filter chips All / Pending / Approved / Done / Rejected, one pending request with Cancel request, and Request a WFH day at the bottom.

26.capture: HAVE IT. My attendance for September 2026: month arrows (forward disabled), the six-count summary with 1 Day Off, '0h 00m worked across 1 recorded day.', and one Day Off card.

27.capture: BLURRED by blur_words.py. the grey footer line 'To change these, open My Profile in ...' names the backend product; blur that word (or the whole line). HAVE IT. My details on the Profile tab: Account card with Name and Username, the Nothing to show yet card, and the Home / Profile bar.

28.capture: Signed in as an ordinary employee, tap the gear on the Home header: Settings / Server and account, the Connection card with Server, Database, Signed in as and Username (test account), and no extra line below the card.
